question.worked_solution:
The expected value of a discrete random variable $X$ with probability mass function $f(x)$ defined over a set $S$ is given by

$$
\text{E}[X]={\sum }_{x\in S}x\cdot f(x).
$$

Let $X$ be the outcome of the spinner. Then the support is $S=\{-2,-1,0,1,2,3\},$ and the corresponding probabilities are all $\frac{1}{6}:$

$$
f(-2)=f(-1)=f(0)=f(1)=f(2)=f(3)=\frac{1}{6}
$$

Summing up the products of each value of $X$ and its associated probability, we get

$$
\begin{aligned}\text{E}[X] & =-2\cdot f(-2)+(-1)\cdot f(-1)+0\cdot f(0)+1\cdot f(1)+2\cdot f(2)+3\cdot f(3) \\  & =-2(\frac{1}{6})+(-1)(\frac{1}{6})+0(\frac{1}{6})+1(\frac{1}{6})+2(\frac{1}{6})+3(\frac{1}{6}) \\  & =-\frac{2}{6}-\frac{1}{6}+0+\frac{1}{6}+\frac{2}{6}+\frac{3}{6} \\  & =\frac{-2-1+0+1+2+3}{6} \\  & =\frac{3}{6} \\  & =\frac{1}{2}.\end{aligned}
$$
